}

/* ---------- BUTTONS ---------- */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:46px;padding:0 22px;border-radius:999px;
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.35s var(--ease);white-space:nowrap}
.btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex:0 0 auto}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent-2),#5d8d1c);color:#08211a;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(201,118,29,.34),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.34)}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(201,118,29,.44),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.btn-ghost{background:rgba(236,230,247,.10);border:1px solid rgba(236,230,247,.30);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);color:var(--surface)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(236,230,247,.18);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-sm{height:38px;padding:0 18px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em}

/* ---------- REVEAL ---------- */
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);filter:blur(7px);transition:opacity .95s var(--ease),transform .95s var(--ease),filter .95s var(--ease)}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}
.rv-d1{transition-delay:.09s}.rv-d2{transition-delay:.18s}.rv-d3{transition-delay:.27s}.rv-d4{transition-delay:.36s}.rv-d5{transition-delay:.45s}

/* ---------- PROGRESS RAIL ---------- */
.rail{position:fixed;right:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:44;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
@media(min-width:1180px){.rail{display:flex}}
.rail a{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(236,230,247,.26);transition:.3s var(--ease);position:relative}
.rail a.on{background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(240,160,60,.18);height:22px;border-radius:999px}

/* ---------- TICKER ---------- */
.ticker{position:relative;z-index:40;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:rgba(23,16,43,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(236,230,247,.10);color:var(--paper-2)}
.ticker .track{display:inline-flex;gap:40px;padding:9px 20px;animation:tick 30s linear infinite}
.ticker b{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
@keyframes tick{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ---------- NAV ---------- */
header{position:fixed;top:38px;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;padding:0 14px;transition:top .4s var(--ease)}
header.up{top:10px}
.navpill{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;flex:0 0 auto}
.brand .mark{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(240,160,60,.26),rgba(75,58,143,.42));border:1px solid rgba(236,230,247,.24)}
.brand .mark svg{width:23px;height:23px}
.brand .txt{line-height:1.05}
.brand .n1{display:block;font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.06;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--surface)}
.brand .n2{display:block;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--paper-3)}
.nav{display:none;gap:26px;margin:0 auto;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500}
.nav a{color:var(--paper-2);padding:6px 0;position:relative;transition:.3s}
.nav a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:100%;bottom:0;height:1.5px;background:var(--accent);transition:right .35s var(--ease)}
.nav a:hover{color:var(--surface)}
.nav a:hover::after{right:0}
.navtools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-left:auto}
.ico{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--paper-2);transition:.3s;position:relative}
.ico:hover{background:rgba(236,230,247,.14);color:var(--surface)}
.ico svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.dot{position:absolute;top:5px;right:5px;min-width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent-2);color:#08211a;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 4px}
.burger{display:grid}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .ico.hide-s{display:none}
  .brand .mark{width:34px;height:34px}
  .brand .n1{font-size:14.5px}
  .brand .n2{font-size:7.6px;letter-spacing:.2em}
  .navpill{gap:10px;padding:8px 10px}
}
@media(min-width:1024px){.nav{display:flex}.burger{display:none}}

/* ---------- HERO ---------- */
.hero{position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:150px 0 var(--sec-y)}
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(102deg,rgba(1,45,42,.68) 0%,rgba(1,45,42,.40) 30%,rgba(1,45,42,.10) 52%,transparent 66%)}
@media(max-width:900px){.hero::before{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(1,45,42,.44) 0%,rgba(1,45,42,.22) 34%,rgba(1,40,38,.60) 100%)}}
.hero-grid{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px;width:100%;position:relative;z-index:2}
.hero-copy{max-width:600px;position:relative;z-index:3}
.hero h1{margin-bottom:20px;text-shadow:0 6px 40px rgba(2,20,19,.55)}
.rule{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin:0 0 20px;max-width:270px}
.rule i{height:1px;flex:1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(236,230,247,.44),transparent)}
.rule svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--accent);flex:0 0 auto}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}

/* product */
.hero-prod{position:absolute;right:2%;bottom:28px;width:min(50vw,560px);z-index:2;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 34px 54px rgba(2,20,19,.6))}
@media(max-width:1200px){
  .hero-copy{max-width:470px}
  .hero-prod{width:min(44vw,440px);right:3%}
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero{align-items:flex-end;padding-top:132px}
  .hero-copy{max-width:none}
  .hero-prod{position:relative;right:auto;bottom:auto;width:min(88vw,420px);margin:20px auto 0}
}

/* badge rail */
.badges{position:absolute;right:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:96px;z-index:4;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:12px 8px;border-radius:20px}
.badge{text-align:center;padding:11px 4px}
.badge+.badge{border-top:1px solid rgba(236,230,247,.14)}
.badge .bi{width:38px;height:38px;margin:0 auto 8px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:rgba(236,230,247,.10);border:1px solid rgba(236,230,247,.22);color:var(--accent)}
.badge .bi svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.badge span{display:block;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--paper-2);line-height:1.34}
@media(max-width:900px){.badges{display:none}}

/* mobile badge strip */
.badgestrip{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:24px}
.badgestrip div{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:11px 6px;border-radius:14px;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--paper-2);line-height:1.3}
.badgestrip svg{width:18px;height:18px;margin:0 auto 6px;color:var(--accent)}
@media(min-width:901px){.badgestrip{display:none}}
